description: This file defines the interface for RISC-V specific kernel interrupt handling, including macros, external function declarations, and interrupt constants.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ line is enabled.

methods.name: z_riscv_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority and flags for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: sys_trace_isr_enter
methods.description: Trace function called upon entering an ISR.

methods.name: sys_trace_isr_exit
methods.description: Trace function called upon exiting an ISR.

methods.name: __soc_handle_irq
methods.description: Handles the IRQ based on the mcause value.
